name: Are permits required for concrete sidewalk repair in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: Are permits required for concrete sidewalk repair in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most minor repairs or sections of sidewalk entirely on private property, a permit may not be required. However, if the repair involves significant reconstruction, altering drainage, or impacts a public right-of-way sidewalk, a permit from the City of Las Vegas or relevant municipal authority might be necessary. We can help you determine if your project requires a permit and guide you through the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor repairs on private property usually don't need permits. Significant work or public right-of-way repairs may require city permits.
